{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "relational",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish in front of the whole assembly, twisting the sacrifice to name Lirael’s wound instead of her own, and the presiding Dohkar is already reacting to the misalignment as it lands",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-invocation, her hands trembling as she glances at Lirael instead of the Dohkar’s sash, the practiced words dissolving into something raw and unscripted.",
    "rising_beats": [
      "Lirael’s fingers tighten around the ceremonial sash, the fabric biting into her palms as she realizes Seren is naming the wound she was supposed to conceal.",
      "Julian shifts at the edge of the gathering, his gaze locked on Lirael’s face, the only one who understands the rule Seren is breaking."
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she muffle her cry behind the cloth or rip it away to stop the wish before it twists further?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant-in-training",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the deep-crimson braided spiralgrass carpet",
      "the pale mated-pair trees’ hanging leaf-curtains"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": "Seren — the youth making her First Sacrifice, her hands trembling as she clutches the Dohkar’s sash, the way she always does when she’s afraid of being wrong.",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "beat 1 — Lirael clutches the ceremonial sash tighter, the embroidered vines biting into her skin, the way she does when she’s trying not to show how much something hurts.",
    "scene_want": "wants Seren to stop before the whole assembly realizes what she’s doing, but also wants Julian to see her struggle without knowing why.",
    "scene_mission": "Stop Seren from twisting the wish before the presiding Dohkar calls for the cost to be spoken aloud.",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "The scene opens with Seren mid-invocation, her voice faltering as she abandons the rehearsed wish, and Lirael realizing she’s breaking the rule in front of everyone.",
      "believes": "The cost of Seren’s sacrifice is about to become public, and Lirael is the only one who can stop it—but doing so will expose her own wound in front of Julian.",
      "wondering": "Why is Julian here, and what does he already know about Lirael’s wound?",
      "must_not_confuse": "Who is making the sacrifice, who is breaking the rule, and why the presiding Dohkar is reacting to the misalignment."
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "beat 1 — stress_tic (the sash’s embroidered vines)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (the way Julian’s gaze lingers on Lirael’s face, not the Dohkar’s sash)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "LEAK",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren’s hands tremble as she clutches the Dohkar’s sash, her voice faltering mid-invocation, the practiced words dissolving into something raw.",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of naming the wound plainly reveals her belief that softening it is kinder than making it endure direct recognition.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren is trying to protect Lirael by blurring the wound, but it’s making everything worse."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The Dohkar’s eyes narrow as Seren’s words twist, his posture stiffening before the assembly can react.",
        "behavior_object_ids": [],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren"],
        "revelation_bridge": "His assumption of authority over the sacrifice’s alignment contradicts the moment’s emotional weight.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "PERSONALIZE_SOCIAL_HARM",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar sees this as a procedural failure, not a moral one."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target": "the deep-crimson braided spiralgrass carpet",
      "axis": "damage",
      "beat": "The carpet’s intricate braids are frayed at the edges where Seren’s bare feet have pressed too hard, the way someone does when they’re trying not to be noticed."
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "Her grip on the sash reveals how much she’s trying not to react—even to herself.",
      "environment_target": "the deep-crimson braided spiralgrass carpet",
      "environment_axis": "damage",
      "beat": "Lirael’s fingers dig into the frayed edges of the carpet, the way she does when she’s trying to stay still while something inside her is breaking."
    }
  }
